audit.why: 49.93% over 693 games with a 6/10 difficulty and a 9.5/10 carry threat is right: Fiora owns levels 1-3, Vayne owns 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Vayne levels 2, 3 and first item, and gave Fiora nothing at level 1 — the exact opposite of the page's own whys text and of the packet chart.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill/Skill/Skill/Vayne. whys[0]-[2] state Vayne has no Tumble until 3 and loses every short trade; whys[5] calls first items even.
audit.corrected: Flipped win[0..2] to Fiora, win[5] to Skill, and the matching full phases[N].side/rating as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn and Tumble were tracked without a single cooldown number, so 'engage when it is down' had no clock attached.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s; Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s — the early Tumble ranks are the only real gap, and that changes when the advice applies.
audit.corrected: Put the real numbers into breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text. Riposte-parries-Condemn is already stated correctly and left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Generic lines refer to Vayne as 'he'/'his'.
audit.why: Vayne is female; the rest of the page uses her/she.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tradeGood, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.feeding.

edits.before: Once Vayne has Tumble the lane evens: the roll resets her auto-attack timer and re-opens the kite gap she needs to sit outside Lunge range, so only commit when her Tumble is on cooldown.
edits.after: Once Vayne has Tumble the lane evens: the roll resets her auto-attack timer and re-opens the kite gap she needs outside Lunge range. It is 6s at rank 1 but 2s maxed — commit inside the early gap.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Riposte it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — wall-stun. Riposte it. - Vayne Tumble: 6s at rank 1, 2s at rank 5 — late she always has it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Vayne, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Vayne, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until her bar forces the all-in she loses.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: If Vayne gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Condemn. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Vayne gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Condemn. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

notes: Riposte returning a stun off Condemn is asserted in three places; it is consistent with Riot's Riposte text (blocked immobilizing effect) and I left it as written. breakdown.trading and report[3] still contain the 'his bar / he loses' phrasing inside a longer composite string — the applier writes those from the same source lines, so fixing tradeGood/tradeBad should carry.
